maxItems.title: Max Dive Logs
maxItems.description: Maximum number of dive logs to scrape. Set to 0 for unlimited within the selected date range.

searchKeyword.title: Search Keyword (Optional)
searchKeyword.description: Optional keyword to filter dive logs (min 3 characters, e.g. 'zeepaardje', 'meerval', 'snoek'). Leave empty to scrape ALL dive logs chronologically.

dateFrom.title: Date From (DD-MM-YYYY)
dateFrom.description: Earliest dive date to scrape in DD-MM-YYYY format (e.g. '01-01-2026'). Defaults to 1 year ago if left empty.

dateTo.title: Date To (DD-MM-YYYY)
dateTo.description: Latest dive date to scrape in DD-MM-YYYY format (e.g. '16-10-2026'). Defaults to today if left empty.

windowDays.title: Date Pagination Window (Days)
windowDays.description: Number of days per search window when stepping backwards through /logberichten (each window returns up to 100 logs; automatically splits if a window hits 100 logs).

spotUrls.title: Specific Dive Spot URLs (Optional)
spotUrls.description: Optional list of Duikersgids dive spot URLs (e.g. https://www.duikersgids.nl/eiland-4) to scrape recent logs directly from those spots.

scrapeLogDetails.title: Visit Individual Log Detail Pages
scrapeLogDetails.description: Enable to visit each individual /logbericht/... page to also extract attached dive photos, diver profile URL/avatar, and region/province text.

enrichWithSpotCoordinates.title: Enrich with Dive Spot GPS Coordinates
enrichWithSpotCoordinates.description: Fetches the Duikersgids dive spots directory once at startup (1,868 spots) to attach stekId, latitude, longitude, and spotUrl to every log.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select proxies to be used by your crawler.
